knowledge:
- key_parameters: expMat=A matrix of count data or normalized counts (e.g., log TPM) where rows are Hugo Symbols and columns are cells ;; cellCusterA=Character vector of cell names/IDs belonging to cluster A (e.g., Malignant cells) ;; cellCusterB=Character vector of cell names/IDs belonging to cluster B (e.g., Immune cells) ;; topRank=Percentage threshold (default 10) to consider a gene expressed in a cell (must be in the top X% of the ranked gene list) ;; PValue=Logical indicating whether to compute p-values based on random permutations ;; pvalueCutoff=Significance threshold for reporting interaction pairs (default 0.05) ;; nPermu=Number of permutations for p-value calculation ;; filterCutoff=Percentage threshold (default 50%) of cells in respective clusters that must express partner A and partner B ;; minLenGeneSet=Minimum number of genes for a signature to be considered in TME classification
- alternatives: None mentioned. The documentation notes that standard marker-gene approaches for TME classification are less accurate than its MWW-GST signature enrichment approach.
- when_to_use: Use when you have single-cell RNA-seq data of tumor and microenvironment cells and want to identify active, statistically significant ligand-receptor interactions between specific cell clusters, or classify TME cells using gene signature enrichment.
- pitfalls: Not all interaction genes might be present in the input expression matrix, which generates a warning. TME_classification can take a long time if the number of cells to test is large. Input matrix must have genes as Hugo Symbols. Interactions are not symmetric; cellCusterA is tested for partner A and cellCusterB for partner B.

workflows.name: ligand_receptor_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify and visualize significant ligand-receptor interactions between two cell clusters from single-cell RNA-seq data.
input: expMat (matrix of single-cell RNA-seq counts/normalized counts with Hugo Symbols as rows and cells as columns)
cell_metadata (annotation of each cell to define cluster groups)
workflows.stages: 1. Define cell clusters of interest ;; 2. Run scTHI_score to compute interaction scores and p-values ;; 3. Plot results using scTHI_plotResult ;; 4. Run t-SNE using scTHI_runTsne ;; 5. Visualize clusters on t-SNE using scTHI_plotCluster ;; 6. Visualize specific interaction pairs on t-SNE using scTHI_plotPairs
workflows.code:
Malignant <-
rownames(H3K27.meta)[H3K27.meta$Type == "Malignant"][1:100]
Immune <- rownames(H3K27.meta)[H3K27.meta$Type == "Immune cell"]

H3K27.result <-
scTHI_score(
expMat = H3K27,
cellCusterA = Malignant,
cellCusterB = Immune,
cellCusterAName = "Malignant",
cellCusterBName = "Immune",
topRank = 10,
PValue = TRUE,
pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
nPermu = 10,
ncore = 1
)

scTHI_plotResult(scTHIresult = H3K27.result,
                cexNames = 0.7,
                plotType = "score")

scTHI_plotResult(scTHIresult = H3K27.result,
                cexNames = 0.7,
                plotType = "pair")

H3K27.result <- scTHI_runTsne(scTHIresult = H3K27.result)

scTHI_plotCluster(scTHIresult = H3K27.result,
                cexPoint = 0.8,
                legendPos = "bottomleft")

scTHI_plotPairs(
scTHIresult = H3K27.result,
cexPoint = 0.8,
interactionToplot = "THY1_ITGAX:ITGB2"
)

workflows.name: tme_classification
workflows.intent: Classify non-tumor cells in the tumor microenvironment into specific immune and stromal cell types using gene signature enrichment.
input: expMat (matrix of single-cell RNA-seq counts/normalized counts with Hugo Symbols as rows and cells as columns, typically subsetted to non-malignant cells)
workflows.stages: 1. Subset expression matrix to TME cells ;; 2. Run TME_classification to classify cells ;; 3. Plot the classification results on t-SNE coordinates using TME_plot
workflows.code:
Tme.cells <-
rownames(H3K27.meta)[which(H3K27.meta$Type != "Malignant")]
H3K27.tme <- H3K27[, Tme.cells]

Class <- TME_classification(expMat = H3K27.tme, minLenGeneSet = 10)

TME_plot(tsneData = H3K27.result$tsneData, Class, cexPoint = 0.8)
